sections.h2: Bio-power grew 19% in six and a half years, while solar grew 384%

chart.title: Bio-power lagged every other non-hydro renewable category
chart.sub: Growth in installed capacity, December 2019 to July 2026, %.
chart.source: CSEP Working Paper 58 (2019, citing CEA); MNRE state-wise capacity table, 31 July 2026.

sections.means: Bio-power's share of non-hydro renewable capacity fell from 11.4% in 2019 to 4.9% in 2026.
sections.todo: Track whether biomass capacity starts to grow once Time-of-Day tariffs reach more consumers.

sections.means: Most of this capacity is sugarcane-bagasse cogeneration attached to sugar mills, not purpose-built biomass plants.
sections.todo: Find out how much of this state-level capacity sells power under purchase agreements rather than for captive use.
